description: Two velvety petunias fill the frame, one dominating the composition and the other peeking in from its upper edge. The purple petals of both flowers shine with vibrant fuscia highlights. The background of the work is pale blue.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Petunias)
